envId.description:
This field is always treated as a regex and will be used for matching all the envIds.
E.g.
If user provides:
ExclusionTarget.make().withEnvId("leslie-envname")
then only one "leslie-envname" env is excluded.
If user provides:
ExclusionTarget.make().withEnvId("leslie-n.*")
then all envs that start with n are excluded.

appId.description:
This field is always treated as a regex and will be used for matching all the appIds.
E.g.
If user provides:
ExclusionTarget.make().withAppId(".*-envname-.*appname")
then all the apps end with "appname" in "envname" are excluded.
If user provides:
ExclusionTarget.make().withAppId(".*-appname")
then every appname app in all of the cluster envs are excluded.
If user provides:
ExclusionTarget.make().withAppId("leslie-envname-appname")
then "leslie-envname-appname" app is excluded.

Note that for mne non-c3 app, if it is excluded, then its parent c3 app will also be excluded.
For sne non-c3 app, it cannot be excluded individually, only DDE env as a whole can be excluded from hibernation.
For sne c3 app, if it is excluded, then the entire sne env as a whole will be excluded.

expirationTime.description:
This field represents when this exclusion target will expire.
If the target is expired, we will no longer exclude it from Hibernation.
If the expirationTime field is null, it will be interpreted as having no expiration time, effectively meaning infinite.
E.g.
ExclusionTarget.make().withAppId('cluster-env-app').withExpirationTime(DateTime.now().plusDays(3))

title:
This type specifies the envId regex or appId regex that are to be excluded during hibernation
And it should not have both envId and appId.
name: ExclusionTarget
